description:
OUR MISSION

Rebuild the global economy for the AI era.




ABOUT BRAIN CO.

Most of the economy was built before AI. Brain Co. builds AI-first organizations so the institutions everyone depends on can serve more people, take on bigger challenges and pursue ideas that have been out of reach.



Our engineers, operators and domain experts work alongside the people inside them to rethink how work gets done, with the first workflows live in weeks. Already deployed inside governments and Fortune 2000 companies, Brain Co. is driving hundreds of millions in annual impact.




WHY NOW

Brain Co. is expanding its products, platform and teams across San Francisco, New York, London, Abu Dhabi and Doha.



You’ll join 200+ people from Palantir, Meta, Harvey, Ramp and Anduril, including many former founders. Everyone here ships. No one is too senior to own the strategy and the work, start to finish. We learn the work from the inside and build for how it really runs.



The institutions everyone depends on deserve the best people in AI.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As an AI Product Engineer, you will work closely with cross-functional teams and leaders to design, build, and deploy AI-powered software that solves real-world problems. This is a highly hands-on role with ownership across the full product lifecycle, from understanding customer needs to shipping production-grade AI applications.

You’ll contribute directly to live projects used by governments, healthcare systems, and industrial partners, turning cutting-edge AI into reliable, scalable products.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

Build & Ship Real Products: Design and develop AI-powered features across front-end, back-end, and data workflows. Prototype and ship internal tools and customer-facing applications using modern web technologies

Translate Problems into Products: Work with product managers and other engineers to turn customer problems into clear product requirements and integrate AI models into real-world software systems

Optimize & Improve: Improve the performance, reliability, and usability of deployed applications. Analyze data, evaluate AI outputs, and iterate based on real customer feedback

Make a Real Impact: Own work that modernizes government workflows, improves healthcare outcomes, or optimizes critical infrastructure. See your work deployed and used by real users—not just internal demos




YOU WILL THRIVE IF YOU

 - Expect to complete a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field in Spring 2027.

 - Have strong software development fundamentals demonstrated through internships, research, substantial coursework, or personal projects.

 - Can build software using several of Python, TypeScript, React, REST APIs, SQL, and cloud platforms

 - Understand the fundamentals of AI systems and product thinking, and are excited by real-world machine learning applications

 - Enjoy solving ambiguous problems and learning quickly in fast-paced environments

 - Communicate clearly, collaborate well, and take ownership of your work

 - Are excited to work directly on impactful problems rather than purely theoretical projects




JOB DETAILS & BENEFITS

 - Eligibility: Completing a bachelor’s degree in Spring 2027.

 - Competitive full-time compensation and benefits

 - Support and feedback from experienced engineers, researchers, and product leaders

 - Opportunity to work on real production systems used globally

 - Meaningful ownership from day one, with room to grow alongside the team

 - Daily lunches (if onsite)
